implemented: Added an optional ABM dependency for calibration flow support, an experimental TransitContext::schedule_transit_retry seam using schedule_domain_and_bind, and Bound route construction, exact event tracking, receipt validation, explicit retry, and accepted-arrival request/work reconciliation.
Kept Macro and zero-duration Micro submissions transit-free; nonzero Micro routes validate route geometry before sampling and use the actual carrier context.
Added atomic checks for malformed, forged accepted, wrong-event, foreign-runtime, changed retained carrier/kind/priority, wrong scheduler kind, replay, and scheduler-count preservation on failure.

Corrected the C20 fixture imports and registration to use the existing receipt-aware register_transit_context API; behavioral assertions remain unchanged. Repeated invalid transit control now reports InvalidState as required by the frozen fixture, and the ABM regression reflects that contract.

verification.summary: 17 ABM tests passed; 76 calibration tests passed; 2 calibration tests ignored

verification.command: PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/bin:/bin CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/tmp/kairo-c2-route-target /opt/homebrew/bin/cargo clippy --locked -p kairo-ecs-calibration -p kairo-ecs-abm --features kairo-ecs-calibration/flow --all-targets -- -D warnings

limitations: The retry regression supplies a structurally matching rejected FlowDispatch rather than obtaining a scheduler-generated rejected expected start/progress callback. FlowRuntime has no bounded injection hook for that scenario; adding a DES test hook or exhausting its u32 scheduler cap would exceed this packet. Bound therefore relies on the documented cooperative caller-provenance boundary, while the ABM seam performs structural lineage checks.
This result is ready for independent review only. It does not accept C2.3, C2.1, C2.4, release compatibility, or clinical validation.
